messages.author: 9d8fa434123d96b8
messages.subject: TMT cross run normalization
parts:
Hi:
This is just a simple question, I guess.
When having multiple TMT runs, in order to obtain comparable protein intensities between those runs, a reference channel should be used in all the runs (mixtures), and then in the call to function "MSstatsTMT::proteinSummarization", the parameter "reference_norm" should be set to TRUE and the annotation file should have "Norm" in the channels corresponding to the reference sample.
My question is, when doing that, and making a scatter plot of the protein intensities of the reference channels in different runs (mixtures),  shouldn't all the points align in the diagonal? in other words, aren't the intensities of the proteins of the reference channels equalized? I am making that check and I don't see that in my plot, and I am not sure if I am doing something wrong. I am getting the data at protein level by getting $ProteinLevelData over the object returned by proteinSummarization function.
Please, I would appreciate any guidance on this.
Thanks!

Salva.
